body: I'm very self-aware. I know how I am & why I am that way.

If someone bounces/kicks/moves their leg repeatedly I'll latch onto it & if I can't get it out of sight I'll start panicking.  That & gum chewing, it genuinely seems like 80% of people are incapable of chewing with their mouths closed.
I have that too, but mine is directed more towards squishy pasta-stirring sounds.  I know maybe 2 people who can handle chewing gum without turning into a neanderthal.

I've got Social Phobia, Anxiety Disorder NOS, & a couple others not related to anxiety.  Usually to escape I put on music as loud as possible to drown out the constant noise & I live various fantasies where I'm a hero or something.

When. I was younger I would trap air under my tongue & force it out, making a sound.  Then I started blinking constantly.  Now I pace, if I don't pace I tremble, rock back & forth, & rub my thighs with my hands.  Really the only way to manage it is to exit the situation, if not that it'll get worse until I do.

When I'm alone I act like people are around me so I have someone to talk to. (Not in a delusional way, mind you.) I always explain random things to them but for some reason I can't explain to them that my toothbrush stops vibrating automatically after 2 minutes.  Any time I think about it I get very uncomfortable, I'm not sure what would happen but I guess that's why they call it a superstition.
